test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If V & S @ F % H # T @ Q, then how is V related to H?
solution:
From the given information:

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

Now we substitute the values in the given equation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6063effc226003fb11ddf6de65ef3cf0f4fcc92c9d56a2a90d345a45e16b1ef7.png] 

V is the husband of S, S is the daughter of F, F is the wife of H, H is the brother of T, T is the daughter of Q.

Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad645443421ee1467340d32e8b631ca12c1d546e961b8e6cca4d011767934ed9.png] 

So according to the diagram we can see that **V is daughter's husband of H.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
